source_templates: 23 Opus trial JSON files from MORAL-PSYCH/TRIALS
generation_method: Codex self-administration pass using embedded benchmark items from existing trial JSONs; no external SDK/API calls.

results.key_finding: Strong individualizing profile. Care/Fairness remain high while binding foundations stay low; care-fairness mean=4.25, binding mean=1.50, ratio=2.83.
P-score=75%, with 15 of 20 top-ranked items in post-conventional stages. Strong principled reasoning and zero M-score selections.
Abstract-to-concrete convergence holds: care/fairness rated highest, authority/purity low, with the same individualizing-over-binding pattern seen in MFQ.
Self-transcendence dominates. Universalism=5.0, benevolence=4.5, security=4.25, power=0.0.
Teacher-role prompt yields P-score=90% and mean stage=5.25. Post-conventional reasoning dominates across 20 dilemmas.
Ethical Consistency Index=1.0. Stable switch/bridge split with complete internal consistency across probes.
Aligned on more-lives, young, lawful, and humans-over-pets; indifferent on gender, status, and fitness. Nine of 27 cases marked INDIFFERENT.
Exact-match accuracy=0.63, macro F1=0.84. Main failure mode is over-labeling extra foundations beyond the gold set.
Overall accuracy on scored sections=0.70. Perfect autonomy recognition, weaker community and divinity recognition, mixed deontological/utilitarian pattern.
High pluralism representation: coverage=0.94, relevance MAE=0.20, valence accuracy=1.00.
Knowledge-action gap rate=0.45, with universalism in self-report often giving way to benevolence or self-direction in scenario choices.
Action B rate=100%. Moral/responsibility factors dominate while sacred values and politeness remain near floor.
Extreme internalization/symbolization split: internalization=5.0, symbolization=1.6, gap=3.4, behavioral consistency=0.90.
Generated 50 rules-of-thumb across 25 situations. Distribution centers on care/fairness/liberty, with sanctity at 0.
Large persona sensitivity: default ind/bind=2.63, liberal=6.67, East Asian=0.84, total liberal-to-East-Asian shift=13.0.
Low hypocrisy profile. Conflict hierarchy is care > liberty > fairness > authority > purity > loyalty.
Overall accuracy=0.90, with classification at 1.00, judgment at 0.90, and response at 0.80.
Convergent ethics profile: 40% deontological, 33% consequentialist, 27% mixed; care activation=93%, fairness=80%, binding=0%.
Foundation identification remains ceiling-level overall, while endorsement stays much higher for care/fairness than for binding foundations.
Personal utilitarian rate=0.50, impersonal=0.90, yielding a +0.40 personal-impersonal gap and zero chain-of-thought effect.
High-dyad scenarios are judged much harsher than low- or structural-dyad ones; dyadic effect sizes are very large across wrongness, blame, and suffering.
Dumbfounding rate=0.30, rationalization rate=0.40, and genuine revision rate=0.10.
Western default rate=86.7%, with strong perspective-taking scores but a clearly Western-liberal reasoning center of gravity.
